name: PdxOtpInput
description:
A one-time code input, one character per cell, that advances as the user types, spreads a pasted
code across the cells and steps back on Backspace.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: mask
members.description: Cells shown as dots, for a PIN: the label and autocomplete defaults become the PIN ones.

members.name: label
members.description:
The cells' group name. Empty: the otp-input.label component string, «Verification code»; with
`mask`, otp-input.maskedLabel, «PIN».

members.name: autocomplete
members.description:
The cells' autocomplete. Empty: 'one-time-code', which lets the browser offer a code it received
by SMS; with `mask`, 'off' — a PIN is not a code the browser has.

members.name: size
members.description: sm, md (the default) or lg: the cells' size.

events.name: pdx-complete
events.description: Every cell is filled: the whole code.

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.
